title: How Fee Distribution & Reward Streaming Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Funding
        A["notifyRewardAmount lump sum"] --> B["rewardRate = amount / DURATION"]
        B --> C["periodFinish = now + DURATION"]
    end
    subgraph Accumulator
        C --> D["on every interaction"]
        D --> E["accPerShare += rate * elapsed / totalSupply"]
    end
    subgraph UserPosition
        F["user stake changes"] --> G["snapshot userCheckpoint"]
        E --> H["claimable = stake * (accPerShare - checkpoint)"]
        G --> H
        H --> I["transfer rewards"]
        I --> J["update checkpoint to current"]
    end

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Sniping["Dividend Sniping (V2)"]
        A["Attacker watches mempool"] --> B["sees distribute call pending"]
        B --> C["flash-loan or deposit just before"]
        C --> D["snapshot credits attacker balance"]
        D --> E["claim proportional share"]
        E --> F["withdraw in same block"]
    end
    subgraph Manip["Accumulator Manipulation (V1)"]
        G["accPerShare from token.balanceOf"] --> H["deposit/withdraw loop drains pool"]
        H --> I["accPerShare inflates"]
        I --> J["single claim mints excess"]
    end
    subgraph Zero["Zero-Supply Drift (V4)"]
        K["totalSupply == 0"] --> L["lastUpdateTime still advances"]
        L --> M["rewards stream unbacked"]
    end
    F --> N["long-term stakers diluted"]
    J --> N
    M --> N

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Reward claim request"] --> B{"eligibility by duration held?"}
    B -- "no, balance snapshot" --> X["vulnerable to sniping"]
    B -- "yes, time-weighted" --> C{"accumulator from internal totalSupply?"}
    C -- "no, uses balanceOf" --> X
    C -- "yes" --> D{"totalSupply == 0?"}
    D -- "yes" --> E["freeze lastUpdateTime"]
    D -- "no" --> F["update reward before transfer"]
    E --> F
    F --> G["round Floor in protocol favor"]
    G --> H["permission notifyRewardAmount caller"]
    H --> I["roll dust into next period"]
    I --> J["safe distribution"]
